IDENT.title: An integrated data- and capability-driven approach to the reconfiguration of agent-based production systems
IDENT.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No general definition; agent types defined, e.g. RA represents a production resource and interfaces MAS with resource control system.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote:
An agent of this type represents
a production resource and is the interface between the
MAS and the control system of the resource.

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote:
The reconfiguration of a production system is handled by
a MAS.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote:
PAs are queried recursively in a depth-first search

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote:

All the changes made by
all the engineers of group 1 were recorded in an experience
base.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Experience base of (state, adjustment, state) instances; event base of state events; history of resources used and capabilities.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote:
The
MAS keeps a history of all the resources that have been used
and their capabilities.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote:
A “publishsubscribe” asynchronous communication mechanism is
employed, whereby RAs publish sensor data

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote:
Each PA has an associated CA, which is aware of the
capabilities of the (sub)system controlled by the PA.

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote:
In future reconfigurations, when a resource for
which experience has been captured is plugged in, the
system will be able to recommend

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Sensor data generated by production resources is
collected by the associated RAs to derive state information.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote:
Upon deployment,
a RA informs its PA parent of its capabilities, which, in turn,
informs the associated CA.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Note that our
approach does not involve agent-mediated auctions

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: The MAS has a hierarchical structure.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote:
A method for both checking the “realisability” of a product by matching required operations and capabilities,
and adapting resources is introduced.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Hierarchical PA/CA/RA/DA MAS without product agents or negotiation; unification-based capability matching; kNN experience-based learning from human integrator adjustments to recommend changes.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote:
Note that our
approach does not involve agent-mediated auctions

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote:
a common taxonomy with a
shared terminology for all the capabilities and product specifications is necessary.

note that the MAS structure is
dynamic, since resources can be added or removed and the
